🔥 FINAL PROBLEM STATEMENT (BALANCED & STRONG)
Use this 👇

Problem Statement
Modern workflows increasingly rely on multiple AI tools for different tasks such as coding, design, and content generation. However, these systems operate in isolation, with no shared memory or continuity across platforms.

As a result, users must repeatedly provide the same context when switching between tools, leading to inefficiency and fragmented workflows.

More importantly, this issue is not just a user-level inconvenience but a deeper system limitation — current AI architectures are largely stateless and tool-specific, lacking a mechanism for persistent and reusable memory.

Key Problems
• AI systems do not maintain persistent memory across sessions and tools
• Memory is tightly coupled to individual applications and cannot be reused
• Lack of a unified infrastructure for storing and retrieving long-term context
• Developers cannot easily integrate memory capabilities into their AI systems
• No standard mechanism for sharing context across independent AI tools

Core Problem
❝ There is no unified, programmable memory infrastructure that enables persistent, reusable, and cross-platform context for AI systems and applications. ❞

CREATE TABLE public.activity_logs (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  action character varying NOT NULL,
  source character varying NOT NULL,
  agent character varying,
  memory_id uuid,
  source_id uuid,
  details jsonb,
  description text,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT activity_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT activity_logs_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.agent_context_logs (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id uuid NOT NULL,
  memory_ids jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  source_ids jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT agent_context_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),

);

  CONSTRAINT agent_sessions_owner_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)
);

  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT memory_facts_memory_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (memory_id) REFERENCES public.memories(id),
  CONSTRAINT memory_facts_fact_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (fact_id) REFERENCES public.facts(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.memory_sources (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  memory_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  source_id uuid,
  CONSTRAINT memory_sources_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT memory_sources_memory_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (memory_id) REFERENCES public.memories(id),
  CONSTRAINT fk_memory_sources_source FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES public.sources(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.processing_logs (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  project_id uuid,
  raw_content_hash character varying,
  processed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  was_worth_remembering boolean NOT NULL,
  reason text,
  extracted_count integer,
  owner_id uuid,
  api_key_id uuid,
  CONSTRAINT processing_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT processing_logs_owner_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT processing_logs_api_key_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (api_key_id) REFERENCES public.api_keys(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.projects (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  owner_id uuid NOT NULL,
  name character varying NOT NULL,
  slug character varying NOT NULL,
  description text,
  icon character varying,
  color character varying,
  status character varying,
  status_note text,
  is_default boolean,
  is_pinned boolean,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT projects_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT projects_owner_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.sources (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  owner_id uuid NOT NULL,
  end_user_id uuid,
  type character varying NOT NULL,
  source_app character varying,
  title character varying,
  raw_content jsonb NOT NULL,
  summary text,
  summary_embedding USER-DEFINED,
  source_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  external_ref character varying,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  event_at timestamp with time zone,
  ingested_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  project_id uuid,
  api_key_id uuid,
  CONSTRAINT sources_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT sources_owner_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT sources_end_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (end_user_id) REFERENCES public.end_users(id),
  CONSTRAINT sources_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES public.projects(id),
  CONSTRAINT sources_api_key_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (api_key_id) REFERENCES public.api_keys(id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.users (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  firebase_uid character varying NOT NULL,
  email character varying,
  display_name character varying,
  avatar_url character varying,
  plan character varying,
  is_active boolean,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_login_at timestamp with time zone,
  settings jsonb,
  account_type character varying DEFAULT 'api'::character varying,
  CONSTRAINT users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
CREATE TABLE public.waypoints (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  src_id uuid NOT NULL,
  dst_id uuid NOT NULL,
  weight double precision NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  coactivation_count integer DEFAULT 0,
  last_coactivated_at timestamp with time zone,
  relationship_type character varying DEFAULT 'similar'::character varying,
  CONSTRAINT waypoints_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT waypoints_src_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (src_id) REFERENCES public.memories(id),
  CONSTRAINT waypoints_dst_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dst_id) REFERENCES public.memories(id)
);

for endsem evaluation what things should i show? tell 

Now that I know your project structure, your college expectations, and that this is Sem 6 ESE (external evaluation), here’s the best possible thing to show.

And I’ve thought through all outcomes.

💣 What externals want in Sem 6
They want to see:

✔ Something substantial built
✔ Clear technical depth
✔ Clear future scope for Sem 7
✔ Work that justifies 4 people

They do NOT want:

random product ideas

unfinished flashy features

too many disconnected demos

🎯 What YOU should show in Sem 6
MAIN PRODUCT TO SHOW:
UniMemory Developer Platform
Not consumer side yet.

🔥 Show these 4 products
1. Developer APIs ⭐ (Main product)
Show:

API endpoints:
/ingest

/search

/memories

Say:

“Developers can add long-term memory to their AI apps using UniMemory APIs.”

Demo:
Send conversation → memory stored

Search memory → relevant memories returned

2. Developer Dashboard ⭐
Show:

A simple dashboard with:

API key

Test input

Stored memories

Search results

Say:

“Developers can test and manage their memory APIs from here.”

3. AI Agent Integration ⭐ (WOW moment)
This is the most important live demo.

First:
Show agent without UniMemory

Example:

User:

My name is Shreyas. I’m building an AI startup.

New session:

What do you know about me?

Agent:

I don’t know.

Then:
Show agent with UniMemory

Now:

Agent remembers:

You’re Shreyas and you’re building an AI startup.

Say:

“We didn’t change the model. We added memory externally using UniMemory.”

4. SDKs (npm + pip) ⭐
Show:

Basic usage:

unimemory.ingest(...)
unimemory.search(...)
and

client.ingest(...)
client.search(...)
Say:

“Developers can integrate in JavaScript or Python apps.”

💣 What to show from backend (briefly)
After demo, quickly show:

DBeaver:
sources

memories

processing_logs

Say:

“This is where raw inputs, extracted memories, and pipeline logs are stored.”

⚠️ What NOT to show in Sem 6
Do NOT make these your main focus:

❌ Chrome Extension
❌ MCP server
❌ Cross-tool memory

Why?

Because these are Sem 7 products.

Only mention:

“In the next phase, we are extending this to consumer integrations using browser extensions and MCP.”

🎯 Final Demo Flow (what to physically do)
Slide → Explain project
↓

Show dashboard
↓

Test APIs
↓

Show agent without memory
↓

Show agent with UniMemory
↓

Show DB
↓

Mention next phase (extension + MCP)
💣 Why this is the strongest strategy
Because externals will think:

“They built an actual platform, not just a college demo.”

Final product split:
Sem 6 (NOW)
✔ Developer APIs
✔ Dashboard
✔ SDKs
✔ Agent integration

Sem 7 (NEXT)
✔ Chrome Extension
✔ MCP Server
✔ Consumer Dashboard
✔ Cross-tool memory

🧠 One-line pitch for externals
“In this phase, we built the developer platform for adding long-term memory to AI applications.”

That’s the strongest story you can tell.
